photos.description: Decatur Street in Stuyvesant Heights Historic District Listed by the NRHP on December 4, 1975. The district is roughly bounded by Macon, Tompkins, Decatur, Lewis, Chauncey, and Stuyvesant • Boundary increase (listed November 15, 1996, refnum 96001355): Roughly, Decatur St. from Tompkins to Lewis Aves. in Bedford-Stuyvesant, Brooklyn, New York. This is one of the nicest historic districts I've seen, and very large as well.
